title: Roasted Butternut Squash, Caramelized Shallot & Feta Baked Pasta
originalTitle: Roasted Butternut Squash & Feta Baked Pasta
ingredients: 4 cups peeled and cubed butternut squash (1/2-inch cubes)
1 block (8 oz / 200g) Greek sheep's milk feta cheese
12 oz rigatoni, cavatappi, or rotini pasta (or high-protein pasta)
1 head garlic, top sliced off to expose cloves
2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil + 1 tbsp pure maple syrup or hot honey
6–8 fresh sage leaves, 4 sprigs fresh thyme, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes
2 cups fresh baby spinach or kale + 1/2 cup reserved starchy pasta water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). In a 9x13-inch baking dish, toss the cubed butternut squash, shallots, sage leaves, thyme, and red pepper flakes with olive oil, salt, and pepper.

Nestle the block of feta cheese and the cut head of garlic in the center, drizzle with olive oil and maple syrup, and bake for 35–40 minutes until the squash is caramelized and the feta is soft and golden.
Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente, reserving 3/4 cup starchy pasta water before draining.

Squeeze the roasted garlic cloves out of their skins, mash half of the roasted butternut squash with the melted feta and pasta water into a velvety orange sauce, and fold in the pasta and baby spinach until wilted.
